From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-04-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Senior review lateral-move exceptions and comms kit

Hi team,

I pulled together a focused kit for handling senior-level reviews where a lateral move (internal transfer) is in flight during the review window. The goal is to provide managers a single, low-risk playbook so we avoid leaking compensation intent or mishandling sensitive change-of-role timing.

What I attached:
- senior_comm_templates_v2.docx — manager templates: conversation script, manager checklist, and a redaction-ready announcement template.
- redaction_checklist_v1.pdf — what to strip when moving packets into restricted storage.
- exec_signoff_matrix.xlsx — approval matrix for exceptions (who signs at director+ level).

Ask: please review the templates and redaction checklist and flag anything that would need Legal or Executive Office signoff. Specific concerns to surface:
1) Wording that could imply guaranteed compensation increases for lateral moves.
2) Any phrasing that requires special nondisclosure or non-disparagement language for this cohort.
3) Timing: we need a final signs-off path if a role decision is still pending at compensation meeting (proposal: a 7-day fallback hold).

Timeline: I'd like to lock the templates by EOD 2026-04-16 so People Ops can run a redaction pass before manager training in May.

Thanks,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Eng Org Design (interim)
Redwood Inference

Tessa — thanks for pulling this together, looks tidy. Quick notes inline and a couple asks: 

- Add a checkbox on the manager form for "lateral-move exception requested" with a required justification field (helps downstream audits).
- For the 7-day fallback hold, can we be explicit about who owns the hold and how the compensation committee will be notified? Suggest: People Ops owns the hold; Compensation Review (CompRev) gets a weekly digest.
- Please add an example manager script for "decision pending" that is shorter (one paragraph) — managers will prefer a script they can read aloud in 60 seconds.

I can make the checkbox and short script edits and push a v2.1 if you want. Also, flagging that when we reference exec signoff we should have the ExecOps distribution list spelled out so approvals aren't delayed.

-L

Attached is a redline of the templates (I renamed for version control). Major changes I propose:
- Separate the public-facing announcement template from the private manager notes; keep manager notes in a secure packet only.
- Add a simple "redaction log" page so People Ops can record what was removed where (helps audits).
- Replace the generic "ExecOps distribution list" with explicit roles: CFO, Head of People, and CompRev chair (names to be populated before final sign-off).

I've also attached an updated redaction checklist with a small legal-oriented section (phrasing to avoid) — this is not Legal signoff, just wording tweaks.

Attachment: redaction_checklist_v1.pdf (updated with legal hints).

I think we should get a quick legal read before sharing with managers. Once Legal thumbs-up, I'll schedule a 30-min walkthrough with the Director cohort.
